name: jsqlite
description: Compose Node.js ESM modules from entries stored in SQLite

scripts.build:pi: node bin/jsqlite.js import-git ../pi apps/p3/src/pi.ts examples/pi.sqlite pi --limit=5 --history=apps/p3/src --force
scripts.demo: node bin/jsqlite.js build examples/demo.manifest.json .tmp/demo.sqlite --force && node --import ./src/register.js examples/demo.mjs
scripts.run:pi: node bin/jsqlite.js run examples/pi.sqlite pi isPiName --args='["work"]'
